claim_limit: Representative visual acceptance of six locations in one EPUB.js/Chromium runtime; not an all-reading-system or human accessibility certification.

defects_closed.defect: Flattened mixed Punjabi/English section labels reordered parentheses in navigation.
defects_closed.repair: Navigation now uses the native Punjabi label; the full English bridge remains in an explicitly isolated span in the chapter heading.

defects_closed.defect: RTL list flow collided with LTR unit paths and SHA-256 labels in provenance.
defects_closed.repair: Unit identifiers, paths, labels and digests now occupy explicit LTR blocks; redundant list numerals are suppressed.

defects_closed.defect: Punjabi MathML text inherited the LTR direction of the enclosing formal expression.
defects_closed.repair: Arabic-script mtext runs are explicitly marked RTL while math roots remain LTR.

rendering.vertical_continuation: Viewport captures are representative scroll positions; material below the viewport remains available through ordinary reflow/scrolling.

observations: Punjabi title and subtitle join correctly in Noto Naskh Arabic.
Seven-unit scope notice is visible and the English credit/revision block remains readable as LTR content.
No horizontal clipping or overlapping elements are visible.
The chapter hierarchy and all six native Punjabi section labels are visible in reading order.
Native-only navigation labels avoid the mixed-direction parenthesis reversal found in the first visual candidate.
Landmarks are present and no line collides with another.
The honest partial-scope box, chapter title, source-unit citation and first section appear in semantic order.
Punjabi prose is RTL with correctly isolated English bridges and LTR mathematical variables.
Line wrapping is natural at 360 CSS pixels with no horizontal clipping.
Set-builder mathematics remains visually distinct from Punjabi prose.
The accessible SVG union diagram has two labelled boundaries and highlights the complete union, including the overlap.
The Punjabi structural text alternative begins directly below the diagram without collision.
Angle brackets, braces, equality and inequality symbols render as native mathematics rather than raw TeX.
Punjabi mtext inside the mixed equality display is explicitly RTL while the encompassing formal sequence remains LTR.
Definition and exercise numbering remain legible and no display causes page-wide horizontal overflow.
Scope, native MathML disclosure and seven-unit provenance heading are visible in Punjabi.
Unit IDs, source paths, SHA-256 labels and digests are isolated as LTR blocks and wrap without bidi collision.
The redundant ordered-list markers found in the second visual candidate have been removed.
